## DESCRIPCIÓN

Es un antimicótico tópico en forma de shampoo a base de Ketoconazol 2%. El Ketoconazol es un fármaco antimicótico azólico, de la clase imidazol, en la cual se encuentran Clotrimazol, Miconazol, Econazol, Oxiconazol, Sulconazol, Bifonazol, Tioconazol, Fluconazol e Itraconazol como los más importantes.

## INDICACIONES

Keto Clean Shampoo está indicado, en perros, gatos y equinos para la limpieza del pelaje, regulador de pH y control de microorganismos de origen fúngico ocasionadas por: Microsporum canis, Microsporum gypseum, Trichophyton mentagrophytes, Trichophyton tonsurans, Trichophyton rubrum, Trichophyton verrucosum, Malassezia pachydermatis, Epidermophyton floccosum, Candida
albicans.

## MODO DE USO

Mojar completamente el pelo y la piel del animal. Aplicar Keto Clean Shampoo, en cantidad suficiente, dando masaje vigoroso.

-Perros: 20 mL para un animal de talla y pelaje medio.

-Gatos: 5 a 10 mL.

## COMPOSICIÓN GARANTIZADA

Cada 10 Ml de shampoo contienen:

  * Ketoconazol  2g
  * Excepientes  c.s.p 100 ml

## Ketoconazole Chlorhexidine Shampoo for Dogs, Cats & Horses

Maintaining clean, healthy skin and coat is an important part of routine animal care.

Keto-C® Medicated Shampoo combines Ketoconazole 1% and Chlorhexidine Gluconate 2% in a pleasantly scented cleansing formula for dogs, cats, and horses. It is designed for veterinary-focused skin and coat care while helping maintain healthy skin and coat.

Stratford Animal Care provides veterinary-focused dermatology and grooming products developed to support the skin and coat care needs of companion animals.

### What Is Keto-C® Medicated Shampoo?

Keto-C® is a medicated cleansing shampoo formulated for dogs, cats, and horses. It combines Ketoconazole and Chlorhexidine Gluconate in one convenient formula for veterinary-focused skin and coat care.

Unlike a standard cosmetic shampoo, Keto-C® contains specific active ingredients and is intended to be used according to its product directions or your veterinarian's guidance.

### Ketoconazole and Chlorhexidine in Keto-C®

Keto-C® combines two active ingredients in one pleasantly scented shampoo.

#### Ketoconazole

Keto-C® contains 1% Ketoconazole as an active ingredient in its skin and coat cleansing formula.

#### Chlorhexidine Gluconate

Keto-C® contains 2% Chlorhexidine Gluconate as an active ingredient and is formulated to thoroughly cleanse the skin and coat.

Together, these active ingredients provide a convenient cleansing formula for dogs, cats, and horses.

### When Is Keto-C® Shampoo Used?

Keto-C® Medicated Shampoo is designed for veterinary-focused skin and coat care in dogs, cats, and horses.

Because individual animals may have different skin and coat care needs, follow the product label directions and consult your veterinarian when appropriate.

### Product Details & Options

  * Active Ingredients: Ketoconazole 1% and Chlorhexidine Gluconate 2%
  * Available Sizes: 8 oz, 12 oz, 16 oz, and Gallon
  * For: Dogs, cats, and horses
  * Product Type: Medicated cleansing shampoo
  * Fragrance: Pleasantly scented formula

### How to Use Keto-C® Shampoo

Use Keto-C® Medicated Shampoo according to the product label or as directed by your veterinarian.

Wet the coat thoroughly, apply the shampoo, work it into a lather so it reaches the skin, and rinse according to the product directions.

The appropriate frequency of use may vary depending on your animal's individual skin and coat care needs.

#### Precautions

Avoid contact with the eyes and ears. If irritation occurs or your animal's skin condition worsens, discontinue use and consult your veterinarian.
